column1: # Paintings used as the Neovim background. Tab-separated, three columns:
#   slug  <TAB>  source file  <TAB>  label shown in the picker
# The source file is looked for in ~/Downloads first, then in the paintings
# directory's own src/. import.sh copies it out of Downloads on first run, so
# clearing Downloads later does not break anything.
# The attributions below were identified by eye from the images themselves, not
# read off a museum record. The Rembrandt and the two Cuyps are certain (the
# second Cuyp is signed in the lower right); the rest are confident but worth
# correcting if you know better. Only this column is affected -- it is the label
# in the picker, nothing depends on it.
# Opacity is NOT set here. import.sh measures each painting and computes it, so
# a near-black nocturne and a near-white river scene land at the same faintness.
